# AlumniEmail

> Guides for university IT and alumni relations teams on lifetime alumni email forwarding with Forward Email: how it works, DNS setup, migration from Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, sourced costs and a published university case study. The site is run by the Forward Email team and is not affiliated with the universities it names.

Each page below links to its Markdown copy. HTML versions live at the same path without `index.md`. The full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt](https://alumniemail.com/llms-full.txt).

## Guides

- [Lifetime alumni email forwarding for universities](https://alumniemail.com/index.md): Give graduates a lifetime address on your university domain, forwarded to their own inbox. Flat $250/month, no per-alumnus fee.
- [How alumni email forwarding works](https://alumniemail.com/how-it-works/index.md): How alumni email forwarding works with Forward Email: MX and TXT records, one alias per graduate, SRS, ARC and API provisioning.
- [How to move alumni email off Google Workspace or Microsoft 365](https://alumniemail.com/migrate-from-google-workspace-microsoft-365/index.md): Move alumni accounts off Google Workspace or Microsoft 365: collect destinations, create aliases, switch MX records, export mail.
- [Alumni email cost comparison](https://alumniemail.com/cost-comparison/index.md): Sourced alumni email costs: Forward Email Enterprise at a flat $250/month versus per-user Google Workspace and Microsoft 365.
- [University alumni email case study summary](https://alumniemail.com/case-study/index.md): Summary of Forward Email's alumni email case study: Cambridge, Maryland, Tufts and Swarthmore, with the published cost figures.
- [Alumni email forwarding FAQ for IT staff](https://alumniemail.com/faq/index.md): Answers for university IT staff on alumni email forwarding: storage, logs, DNS, Google and Microsoft coexistence, API and price.
- [About AlumniEmail](https://alumniemail.com/about/index.md): Who runs AlumniEmail, how to reach the Forward Email team, where the source lives, and why the site uses no cookies or trackers.

## Forward Email sources

- [University alumni email case study](https://forwardemail.net/en/blog/docs/alumni-email-forwarding-university-case-study): Forward Email's published case study with university names, alumni counts and cost figures.
- [Plans and pricing](https://forwardemail.net/en/private-business-email): Current Forward Email plans, including the Enterprise plan for universities.
- [Forward Email FAQ](https://forwardemail.net/en/faq): DNS setup, privacy, logging, SRS, ARC and other technical details.
- [Email API reference](https://forwardemail.net/en/email-api): REST API for creating and updating domain aliases.
